boundaryNote: 2021 census-day boundaries and names. Some neighbourhoods have since been renamed or changed.

population.label: Population
population.note: Total population, 2021 Census; counts are randomly rounded.

children.label: Children under 15
children.note: Share of the total population, 2021 Census.

livingAlone.label: One-person households
livingAlone.note: One-person households divided by all private households; rounded counts.

apartments.label: Homes in apartment buildings
apartments.note: Occupied dwellings in buildings with fewer than five or five-plus storeys, divided by all occupied dwellings. Duplexes excluded.

renters.label: Households renting
renters.note: Renter households divided by households by tenure; 25% census sample, rounded counts.

tenantShelter.label: Median tenant shelter cost
tenantShelter.note: 2021 occupied rentals, including utilities where applicable. All dwelling sizes; not today's asking rent. 25% census sample.

transit.label: Commutes by public transit
transit.note: Among employed people 15+ with a usual workplace or no fixed workplace; excludes working at home. 25% sample; pandemic-era travel.

walkCycle.label: Commutes on foot or by bike
walkCycle.note: Same commuting denominator; excludes working at home. 25% sample; pandemic-era travel.

parkland.label: Mapped parkland
parkland.note: Active park polygons published by the City of Edmonton; not a measure of tree canopy or all green space. Share of the neighbourhood covered by the union of park polygons; overlaps counted once.

parks.label: Park sites overlapping the area
parks.note: Park/site records with more than 1 m² inside the boundary, deduplicated by publisher ID or geometry when no ID is supplied. A site spanning two areas can appear in both.

rail.label: LRT stations in or near the area
rail.note: Distinct named stations inside or within 800 m of the boundary, measured in a straight line. Not a walking distance from a home or a service-frequency measure.
